name: Paosgi Azure V1
mode: desktop layout reference — fully original assets
selfDrawnSvgs: hot-card placeholders SW01/SW02/SW03 (gradient rect + dashed border + label)
ipNote: 完全 IP-clean。所有素材為自製簡單幾何 SVG（圓/多邊形/矩形/線段），CSS 從頭寫，未引用 paosgi.com 任何視覺資產或 CSS 規則。Layout 結構（區塊位置/尺寸）為從原站量測的座標數據，不受著作權保護。佔位文字皆以「Sample」標明。

similarityBreakdown.method: scripts/layout-similarity.py — section bounding-box IoU (y 35% + w 15% + h 30% + aspect-ratio 20%) weighted by section importance + 25% doc width + 25% doc height + 50% sections

similarityNote: Desktop 1204×3417 layout-only template. Section positions/dimensions measured from paosgi.com (factual coordinate data); rebuilt from scratch with original HTML/CSS and self-drawn geometric SVG placeholders. Intended use: business team replaces placeholders with their own brand assets when designing a new site. Score reflects structural fidelity, not pixel-level content match.
